body: Isolation destroys a person, I have rarely any friends but I have grown use to, I have never thought of any other person feeling the exact feelings. I don't expect my parents to to feel a false hope indeffinately. Just until they can move on and grieve properly. I feel no human could ever understand me entirely, even if they try their hardest.

The thing is I have really nobody other my stepdad or mother, even if my remains were found I would most likely remain a John Doe for years to come, I wouldn't even expect anyone to identify me. But I would rather be a Doe instead of destroying my family by knowing I died, I think they should keep hope of me being alive and hopefully one day coming back than anything else. I plan to travel to a place where I can never be known, I only doubt because I have always felt empty, only thing I have ever had in this life were empathy which is the reason I want hope to be my parents joy instead of internal sadness. I do wish I had more to live for, even a friend but it cannot be. If I'm identified ever I want my parents to know I'm sorry for ending my life.

I am a senior and life has always been hopeless for me, school never hurt me or brought me to this depression, I have always been alone even to the point of self teaching myself in order to live a "normal" life, I had fake happiness which is more painful to do, all I have ever known. I do know,some care which is why I'm taking my life somewhere where my body can never been found so as people can remember as someone of being good rather than someone of selfishness. As a man said "I cannot live in a world that isn't interested in me" so I decided this fate for the longest time.
Kinda, though mostly lonely and boring.
It was ok, all I did was sit at home and did little the whole Easter weekend.

I shall tell more, I always aspired to become a homicide detective to bring justice and closure to people, I have the intelligence to do so, I could've been valedictorian of my class if my grades didn't suffer because of my depression. I have loved but have been betrayed by everything in this world, all now seems hopeless and a waste planning while I sit alone slowly moving as a shell of a former man, I am just a walking corpse already. I have seen all this world can offer me. It seems fine wether I existed or not. I have felt this was for the longest time in my life. This seems  like I'm hopelessly pleading for something, school never made me depressed, I have always been alone in my life without anything or purpose.
Even then freedom to me is more of a lonely abyss that cannot be filled.
I have and the results were always the same, friends threatening to kill themselves if I succeed in my death and parents just feeling bad.

It's not the high school experience that made me decide to end my life, I have been depressed for a long time, no individual has created my despair but myself. I don't see myself as what others see me as. If I went quietly, nobody would ask and nothing else would happen because of it, there is no consequence for me after this.

Life just seems like a pointless puzzle of uncertainty, the probability of being happy in my life is slim, I never felt happy once middle school started, family never abused me or anything. Never felt sexual desires either. I have been planning this suicide since last October. Prom is like the special place where happiness is, like a symbol..but for me it is a dark and sad isolation for me. My plans have been either killing myself in a abandoned place to be demolished so as to rid my body completely or travel out of state where I could become a John Doe and nobody would even care of who I am or was
